exposure: Original NICHD calculator for VBAC success
Revised NICHD calculator for VBAC success (removed race as a variable)
outcome: Successful vaginal birth after cesarean delivery (VBAC)
Area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 225 patients who underwent a trial of labor after cesarean delivery between 2018 and 2020 at a tertiary academic medical center.
finding: The revised calculator (without race as a variable) increased the average predicted success rates for African American and Hispanic patients, and race/ethnicity did not significantly contribute to the classification ability of the calculator in the study population.
mod_finding: The revised calculator (without race as a variable) improved predicted success rates for African American and Hispanic patients for vaginal birth after cesarean delivery and race/ethnicity did not significantly contribute to the calculator's classification ability.
